sections.text: مقدمة

This document outline the equipment 
inspection checklist I1, which must be performed on monthly bases as indicated 
by M1 in the title block .

Turbine bearing is located up to the hub and is the first bearing from the 
bottom of the unit under the thrust bearing

This bearing function is to carry the radial water 
force component and to keep the shaft vertically

The 
first draft is initiated and tested by eng. Ahmed Abd El Kader Mahmoud, accepted 
by eng. Atty Seiffen general manager, approved by eng. Mohamed Abdel-Baset 
head sector of Aswan Dam (1&2) power stations and certified by eng. Kamel Ragheb 
Hakem HPGC inspection and quality control general director.
احتياطات السلامة

يجب إصدار تصريح العمل والصيانة المؤهلة 
 يجب أن يحمل الموظفون فئة السلامة المناسبة.

Maintenance staff should be will trained and qualified or directly supervised 
 by some one who is.

Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area 
 is required.
Wear your safety and healthy equipment as safety helmet, safety shoes ... etc.
يجب أن تتوقف الوحدة.
The oil circulation pumps must be off.
Gate lock and break on.
